d: Who We Are: At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!

The Military Post Office Site Lead manages daily MPO operations at an assigned overseas installation. This role leads contract personnel, ensures secure and reliable mail services, maintains compliance with military postal requirements, and serves as the on-site point of contact for Government and installation stakeholders. The Site Lead drives operational discipline, customer service, accountability, and mission readiness across all assigned postal functions.
As required by our governmental client, this position requires an active SECRET clearance to be considered.

A government contract requires that this position be restricted to U.S. citizens or legal permanent residents. You must provide documentation that you are a U.S. citizen or legal permanent resident to qualify.
Estimated Starting Salary Range for Site Lead: TBD
Full-time benefits include Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K and other possible benefits as provided. Benefits are subject to change with or without notice.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, or a closely related discipline and a minimum of three (3) years of experience in both supervisory positions and postal service operations; or
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in both supervisory positions and military postal service operations. Experience supporting U.S. Air Force postal operations is preferred.
Demonstrated leadership, supervisory, and team-management capability.
Strong knowledge of postal operations, including mail processing, mail security, accountability, customer service, and records management.
Ability to work independently in an overseas contingency or austere environment.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to prepare reports, manage schedules, maintain records, and use Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
Ability to meet installation-specific deployment, medical, training, and access requirements.
Mut pass pre-employment requirements of Cherokee Federal.
Experience supporting Military Post Offices, Army Post Offices, Fleet Post Offices, or other Department of Defense postal operations.
Prior experience supporting U.S. Air Force postal operations or deployed/overseas military installations.
Knowledge of MPSA, U.S. Postal Service, Department of Defense, and U.S. Air Force postal policies and procedures.
Experience supervising contract personnel under a federal government services contract.
Experience operating in Southwest Asia, the Middle East, or other overseas contingency environments.
Associate degree or higher in business, management, logistics, supply chain management, or a related field.
